articles.title: How did Washington Capitals captain Alex Ovechkin reportedly collect 33 traffic fines in Russia
articles.summary: NHL News: Washington Capitals captain Alex Ovechkin reportedly collected 33 traffic fines in Russia during his offseason, totaling around 82,000 rubles. The fines were for various offenses and have sparked interest due to Ovechkin's celebrity status.
articles.body: Alex Ovechkin reportedly had an unusually high number of traffic violations in his native Russia during a portion of his NHL offseason. According to reports from Russian outlet Mash Sport, the Washington Capitals captain has been fined 33 times over the course of roughly four months. The total reported was 82,000 rubles, or about $1,000 at current media conversions.The alleged violations occurred during Ovechkin's absence from the NHL over the summer. They allegedly included speeding, toll-road violations, unpaid parking fines and stopping or parking in restricted areas. The attention around the story hasnât been on the financial value of the penalties, but rather on the sheer quantity of citations.Why did Alex Ovechkin reportedly receive traffic fines in Russia?During the NHL offseason, Alex Ovechkin was reportedly fined for multiple traffic violations in Russia. The 33 citations were connected to his Aurus Arsenal, a luxury Russian minivan tied to the Washington Capitals star, reports said.The citations reported were for multiple offences, not one repeated offence. One of the infractions was speeding, while other reports also mentioned toll road fines, parking tickets and stopping or parking in restricted areas. All in all, it came to 82 thousand rubles.That means the headline figure of 33 fines does not necessarily equate to 33 separate police stops. Available reports indicate the infractions were traffic-related citations tied to Ovechkinâs vehicle while in Russia for an extended period.Why did Alex Ovechkin reportedly receive traffic fines in Russia?According to reports, Ovechkin has already paid most of the reported fines. One citation was still reported outstanding, worth 4,500 rubles.The number of violations makes the incident unusual, though itâs a relatively small financial penalty in relation to the scale of Ovechkinâs NHL earnings. The 40-year-old forward is still one of the NHLâs most recognisable players, so an off-season stat that included 33 traffic tickets was bound to get some attention.Traffic reports donât mention an NHL suspension, hockey-related discipline, injury or roster issue with the Washington Capitals. Instead, the incident happened away from NHL competition during Ovechkinâs off-season in Russia.Ovechkin will return to Washington for his 22nd NHL season after signing a new one-year contract with the Capitals. He comes into the campaign after scoring 32 goals and 32 assists in 82 games in 2025-26.The timing is odd because Ovechkin has otherwise been spending his offseason preparing for another NHL season. When the new season begins, he will again be a center of attention for the Washington Capitals, who made him the NHLâs all-time regular-season goals leader.For now, the 33 traffic tickets reported are an unusual offseason footnote for a player whose career stats usually center on goals, records and championships.The reports also make it clear that this is about traffic violations, not a legal issue related to his NHL career.Get the latest Sports News and Live updates. articles.title: Tottenham sign Brazilian winger Savinho from Manchester City
articles.summary: Savinho’s arrival, which comes in a busy transfer window for Spurs, takes their spending past $400m.
articles.body:
Tottenham Hotspur have signed Brazil winger Savinho from Manchester City in a deal that takes their close-season spending above 300 million pounds ($409m) under manager Roberto De Zerbi, having just escaped relegation last term.

Both clubs confirmed the transfer on Monday, but the financial details and length of contract were not disclosed. British media last week reported that the deal was worth 75 million pounds ($102.2m) and included a further 10 million pounds ($13.63m) in add-ons.

list 1 of 4 Maresca says he needs time after ‘big changes’ at Man City

list 2 of 4 Arsenal face Man City in Community Shield before EPL return – all to know

list 3 of 4 Marmoush brace helps Man City defeat Atletico Madrid in South Korea

list 4 of 4 Man City beat Palace to close gap with Arsenal to 2, with two games to play

“[Savinho] is a player who brings energy, imagination and quality in wide positions. He has the courage to attack defenders and the ability to change a game with his creativity,” De Zerbi said in a statement.

“We’re very pleased to have him with us, and I’m looking forward to working with him, helping him continue to grow and seeing him bring his personality to the team.”

Savinho started at Atletico Mineiro and joined Troyes in 2022, but his breakout season came on loan at Girona, where he scored 11 goals in 41 appearances as they finished a club-high third in La Liga in 2024 and qualified for the Champions League.

He moved to City in the close season that year and has since made 84 appearances in all competitions, scoring seven goals. The 22-year-old has also played 13 times for Brazil.

Savinho is the latest arrival at Spurs in a busy transfer window that has included the signings of midfielders Sandro Tonali and Mateus Fernandes, plus defenders Andy Robertson, Marcos Senesi and Jan Paul van Hecke.

Savinho’s transfer takes the North London club’s outlay up to 322 million pounds ($438.9m), if the add-ons in the deal are included, as they revamp the squad after finishing a lowly 17th last season.

According to British media, Spurs are also in talks over a move for City’s Egyptian forward Omar Marmoush.

Tottenham began the Premier League campaign with a 3-0 loss at Brentford on Saturday. They next host Championship (second-tier) Charlton Athletic in the League Cup second round on Wednesday before hosting Newcastle United on Saturday.

articles.title: Al volante del Audi más bestia de la historia: 1.001 CV y más rápido que un Lamborghini
articles.standfirst: Hemos conducido el Nuvolari, el Audi de calle más extremo de la historia: 1.001 CV, 351 km/h, DRS y una producción limitada a 499 unidades.
articles.summary: Hemos conducido el Nuvolari, el Audi de calle más extremo de la historia: 1.001 CV, 351 km/h, DRS y una producción limitada a 499 unidades.
articles.body: Para desarrollar desde cero el superdeportivo más potente de su historia, Audi utilizó sus recursos internos para tenerlo listo en tan solo 405 días (poco más de un año), contando desde la primera reunión en la que se aprobó el proyecto. Más concretamente, recurrió a Lamborghini y tomó prestados el chasis y el motor del reciente superhíbrido enchufable Temerario. Para bautizarlo, recurrió al nombre de Tazio Nuvolari, un piloto italiano de enorme talento de las décadas de 1930 y 1940, ganador de carreras de motociclismo, Le Mans, la Mille Miglia y Grandes Premios. En este último caso, a finales de la década de 1930, A finales de la década de 1930, pilotaba monoplazas de Auto Union (la marca que más tarde estaría en el origen de Audi). Su nombre ya se había utilizado en el prototipo que fue precursor de un Audi de producción en 2003, y ahora revive en el que es el coche de producción más potente de la historia de Audi, limitado a 499 unidades. Y con un precio superior a 600.000 euros por unidad. Tecnológicamente, no deja de ser un concepto cercano al de los monoplazas de Fórmula 1 y los prototipos de resistencia actuales, que combina una enorme potencia de propulsión de combustión con la ayuda de la energía eléctrica para mejorar el rendimiento y la tracción, además de incorporar elementos de aerodinámica activa. Y, en este contexto, se posiciona para cumplir el viejo lema del automovilismo de "ganar el domingo para vender el lunes". El Nuvolari es el primer vehículo de producción que adopta la nueva filosofía de diseño de Audi (que, cronológicamente, debutó en el Concept C), y destaca por sus superficies tensas y la configuración de motor central/trasero que define sus proporciones y su volumen monolítico. La carrocería impacta igualmente con el nuevo color exclusivo de Audi, Titanio, utilizado también en el Audi Concept C y en el monoplaza de Fórmula 1. Detrás de esta filosofía de diseño más minimalista (denominada "Radical next") se encuentra Massimo Frascella, el italiano que comenzó su carrera en Bertone, pasó por el Grupo Ford, lideró el diseño de Jaguar/Land Rover y fue contratado a principios del verano de 2024 para definir las líneas de los futuros Audi. “Cada elemento externo cumple una función aerodinámica bien definida, desde el alerón delantero hasta el difusor trasero. Y todo es tal como se ve, ya sea fibra de carbono o aluminio, tanto en el exterior como en el interior”, explica Gael Buzyn, director del centro de diseño avanzado de Audi en Malibú, EE. UU., con quien compartí esta primera experiencia dinámica con el Nuvolari. También llama la atención que la carrocería esté prácticamente desprovista de aristas afiladas, pero eso no significa que su excepcional rendimiento no quede anticipado por sus formas monolíticas y limpias, a diferencia de lo que vemos en un Lamborghini. “La colaboración entre diseñadores e ingenieros fue fundamental, asegurando que cada elemento de la carrocería tuviera una razón de ser funcional”, añade el diseñador francés, quien lleva 20 años afincado en Estados Unidos. En este sentido, "la colaboración de los pilotos del equipo de Fórmula 1, Nico Hülkenberg y Gabriel Bortoleto, fue fundamental durante la fase de desarrollo de este proyecto", como destacó Viktor Underberg, director de Rendimiento de Coches Deportivos de Audi, quien fue mi copiloto durante los aproximadamente 10 kilómetros de esta experiencia exclusiva al volante del Nuvolari. Bortoleto, por ejemplo, mencionó durante el desarrollo dinámico que lo que inmediatamente le llamó la atención en las pruebas de Nardò fue la precisión y previsibilidad del coche en las curvas: "Básicamente, no hay subviraje, lo que es impresionante dado el nivel de rendimiento. El equilibrio se mantiene muy neutro y preciso, lo que proporciona la confianza necesaria para mantener la velocidad en las curvas. Se puede sentir claramente cómo los diferentes sistemas, especialmente la aerodinámica y la distribución del par, trabajan en conjunto", explicó el brasileño.  Underberg (quien había trabajado previamente en Audi antes de su paso por Lamborghini en los últimos años) destaca que "se prestó una enorme atención al equilibrio entre la carga aerodinámica y la resistencia para maximizar la estabilidad y, por consiguiente, permitir un control preciso del Nuvolari". El chasis, la suspensión y la distancia entre ejes son los mismos que los del Temerario, con un ligero aumento del ancho de vía de 1 cm delante y 2 cm detrás. El S-Duct delantero (que entra por el parachoques y sale por el capó) proporciona carga aerodinámica adicional, reduciendo la sustentación a altas velocidades y mejorando la refrigeración del motor. Pero el elemento central del sistema de aerodinámica activa es el ala trasera adaptativa retráctil, que controla la fuerza descendente y la resistencia aerodinámica en tres configuraciones: cerrada, carga baja (low downforce) y carga alta (high downforce). En la posición Cerrada, el ala trasera se retrae para minimizar la resistencia aerodinámica y mejorar la eficiencia. En las configuraciones de alta y baja carga se generan diferentes niveles de carga aerodinámica según la dinámica de conducción y el modo seleccionado (el alerón se eleva desde la posición cerrada a la baja carga a 70 km/h, desciende a 50 km/h y pasa a la posición alta carga a 140 km/h). En los modos orientados al rendimiento, como Dinámico, Dinámico+ y Pista, el ala trasera se activa de forma totalmente automática. En las rectas, el sistema cambia a la posición de baja carga para optimizar la velocidad máxima y la estabilidad. El Sistema de Reducción de Resistencia Aerodinámica (DRS), conocido por su uso en la Fórmula 1, se puede activar manualmente (excepto en el modo E-Hybrid) mediante un botón en el volante, permitiendo así alcanzar una velocidad máxima de 351 km/h. Además, el sistema permite elevar automáticamente el ala en curvas a alta velocidad, de modo que la aerodinámica activa contribuya a la eficacia del pilotaje. Durante la frenada y el paso por curva, adopta la posición CA para aumentar la carga aerodinámica y favorecer el control. En esta configuración, el Audi Nuvolari puede generar más de 400 kg de carga aerodinámica a una velocidad de 290 km/h. El Nuvolari combina un chasis de aluminio con paneles externos de CFRP (plástico reforzado con fibra de carbono). Se utilizan procesos de fabricación derivados del automovilismo, como piezas de fibra de carbono preimpregnadas y curadas en autoclave, para lograr la máxima ligereza y rigidez. El Nuvolari también utiliza llantas forjadas con fijación central de un solo perno, algo único en un modelo Audi de producción en serie (aunque heredado del Temerario). Los neumáticos son 255/35 ZR20 delante y 325/30 ZR21 detrás. El sistema de frenado es electrónico (brake-by-wire), por lo que el pedal de freno no tiene conexión física con las ruedas, como sucede en los sistemas hidráulicos convencionales, ya que el proceso se realiza mediante una bomba controlada electrónicamente. Esto facilita la combinación de frenado regenerativo e hidráulico sin variación en la sensación del pedal. Los frenos emplean discos de carbono-cerámicos con un sistema de refrigeración interno que, según los ingenieros alemanes, mejora la disipación del calor en un 21% en comparación con los discos cerámicos de carbono convencionales. Cuenta con pinzas fijas de diez pistones delante y de cuatro detrás. El Audi Nuvolari quattro está equipado con un sistema de "comportamiento predictivo", un ordenador que procesa datos sobre el ángulo de dirección, la aceleración, la velocidad de guiñada y el agarre disponible. Con esta información, el sistema decide cómo distribuir el par motor, la fuerza de frenado y la carga aerodinámica. Hay cinco modos de conducción para elegir: E-Hybrid, para circular en eléctrico por ciudad o en trayectos cortos; Equilibrado (Balanced), para un buen equilibrio entre confort, eficiencia y rendimiento; Dinámico (Dynamic), que ofrece una respuesta más inmediata; Dinámico+ (Dynamic+), que prioriza el rendimiento; y Circuito (Track), el más extremo, con ajustes específicos para pista, incluyendo niveles más tolerantes en el control de tracción. La arquitectura minimalista concentra todos los controles dinámicos esenciales en el volante, para que el conductor pueda centrarse en su misión y sentirse en el centro del mundo. Antes de conducir el Nuvolari, fui copiloto del CEO de Audi, Gernot Döllner, quien me confirmó que esta filosofía minimalista también se hará más visible en los Audi más convencionales en el futuro. "Por supuesto, no llegaremos al extremo del Nuvolari, un hiperdeportivo que prioriza la conducción sobre el rendimiento, pero sí reduciremos el número de pantallas en los Audi del futuro, porque creemos que la impresión orgánica y los controles físicos/analógicos transmiten una imagen más prémium que las pantallas". Es algo similar al contraste entre los relojes analógicos y digitales en el mundo de la relojería. Los asientos ligeros complementan el concepto de interior centrado en el conductor. La estructura de fibra de carbono en la base y en el respaldo reduce el peso, aumenta la rigidez y proporciona una mayor sujeción lateral. Detrás de los asientos se pueden colocar objetos, algo útil porque no hay maletero bajo el capó delantero (debido al S-Duct ya mencionado). El corazón del Nuvolari está formado por cuatro motores que suman 1.001 CV (736 kW) de potencia máxima. El motor V8 biturbo de 4,0 litros genera 800 CV (588 kW), a los que se suman tres motores eléctricos de flujo axial, cada uno con 150 CV (110 kW). Es el mismo sistema de propulsión que se usa en el Lamborghini Temerario, pero allí entrega 920 CV (debido a una calibración de software diferente) y utiliza una batería más pequeña. Es decir, tenemos un Audi que supera al Lamborghini en potencia e incluso en prestaciones: acelera de 0 a 100 km/h en 2,6 segundos frente a los 2,7 del Temerario y alcanza 351 km/h frente a 343 km/h. Dos motores eléctricos se ubican en el eje delantero y el tercero en el trasero, entre el motor V8 central (que alcanza unas increíbles 10.000 rpm, una cifra más común en coches de carreras) y la transmisión automática de doble embrague de ocho velocidades. Los motores delanteros impulsan el Nuvolari y distribuyen el par de forma variable (cifra no revelada por Audi) entre las dos ruedas delanteras, lo que ayuda a definir la trayectoria en las curvas, mejorar la tracción y aumentar la estabilidad. El tercer motor eléctrico (con 300 Nm de par) complementa la entrega de potencia. Este par se utiliza para eliminar el retardo del turbo, suavizar la entrega de potencia del V8 para generar una respuesta más fluida, próxima a la de un motor atmosférico, acelerar los cambios de marcha y activar la función de Launch Control (arranque desde parado sin deslizamiento de las ruedas). Por lo tanto, si el funcionamiento es el mismo que en el Lamborghini, su contribución al par máximo del sistema será de unos 70 Nm (730 del V8 más estos 70 Nm). La propulsión eléctrica añade 201 CV a los 800 del V8 de gasolina (esa es también la potencia disponible cuando el Nuvolari circula exclusivamente en modo eléctrico) para alcanzar los 1.001 CV mencionados anteriormente. Underberg me explica que potencialmente esta contribución podría llegar a 280 CV, pero eso solo serviría para aumentar la potencia máxima durante un breve periodo: "Preferimos una cifra de potencia máxima menor, 1.001 CV, pero este rendimiento es constante y duradero, y la velocidad máxima se puede mantener durante más de cuatro minutos". El sistema híbrido se alimenta de una batería de iones de litio de 7,3 kWh (casi el doble de capacidad que la utilizada en el Lamborghini), instalada donde normalmente se monta el eje de transmisión en un quattro, que no existe en este caso. Su prioridad es suministrar y recuperar energía rápidamente —el Nuvolari puede desacelerar hasta 0,3 g solo mediante regeneración— y no la autonomía eléctrica, que es secundaria, sobre todo porque una batería más grande aumentaría el peso y perjudicaría el rendimiento. No fue una prueba de conducción exhaustiva (eso vendrá después), sino una primera experiencia al volante del Nuvolari, que, según el ingeniero jefe que me acompañaba, representa al 98% el modelo de producción final. Recorrimos unos 10 kilómetros por una carretera sinuosa dentro de una reserva privada en las afueras del pintoresco pueblo de Carmel, cerca del circuito de Laguna Seca, a 180 kilómetros al sur de San Francisco. Me indicaron que no superara los 70 km/h, así que fue una experiencia de conducción preliminar y tranquila. El sonido del V8 es agradable incluso a bajas velocidades, y las aceleraciones iniciales son impresionantes, aunque evidentemente sin poder acercarnos a sus prestaciones máximas. La dirección es más ligera de lo habitual para un hipercoche, y el volante (revestido en Alcántara) también es más fino, dos claras preferencias de Viktor Underberg, como me confesó anteriormente en la presentación de otros deportivos de Audi, especialmente los modelos RS. Pero no por ello es menos precisa y razonablemente directa (2,5 vueltas del volante de tope a tope). Toda mi atención se centró en la pequeña área del panel de instrumentos y en la cara del volante, donde se ubican los cuatro botones que controlan todo lo relacionado con la dinámica: Launch Control modos de conducción, DRS, programas Wet (Mojado), Dry (Seco) y Recharge (Recarga), modo Track (Circuito) y función de elevación hidráulica del morro (dos centímetros). Al pulsarlos rápida o lentamente se activan diferentes funciones y también se pueden girar para acceder a otras configuraciones… pero resulta confuso controlar tantos reglajes de diferentes maneras. Es cierto que un periodista conduce muchos coches a la semana y acaba necesitando tiempo para familiarizarse con el sistema (yo pasé alrededor de una hora en el coche), pero los futuros propietarios del Nuvolari podrían experimentar algo similar. Al fin y al cabo, en sus garajes probablemente tendrán muchos otros coches que alternarán con el Audi más potente y rápido de la historia. Dejé mis críticas constructivas al director ejecutivo de la marca alemana y al director del proyecto, quienes agradecieron los comentarios, pero será difícil que esto cambie dada la filosofía de base del Nuvolari, centrada en mantener siempre la mirada del conductor en la carretera.

articles.title: The Rock-WrestleMania 43 Speculation and WWE Rumors on Drew McIntyre, Charlotte, Alexa Bliss & SNME
articles.summary: Bleacher Report catches you up on the latest news from the WWE Universe.
articles.body:
Bleacher Report catches you up on the latest news from the WWE Universe.

Even though it's expected the Saudi Arabia government will present several WWE legends with lucrative financial offers to be involved in WrestleMania 43 in some capacity, The Rock's film schedule might prevent him from being part of the event.

While speaking with Variety 's Jack Dunn and Marc Malkin , Vin Diesel said the current plan is to start filming Fast Forever , the final movie in the Fast & Furious franchise, in December.

"We start shooting in December, if I can make good on the request from the studio," Diesel said.

The Rock, who made a cameo appearance in a mid-credits scene at the end of Fast X , is listed in the cast for the new film despite a previous real-life feud with Diesel that played a part in his absence from the eighth and ninth movies.

Steve Carrier of Ringside News noted the filming schedule, particularly for a production of this size, is likely to last months and could stretch into WrestleMania season.

There are variables that could make it so The Rock has a window in his schedule if he wants to be involved at WrestleMania. No one has said the size of his role in the movie, so it's plausible he won't be needed on set for the entire production.

With Saudi Arabia already believed to be paying $250 million to host WrestleMania next year, the expectation is also that the government will present major financial offers to WWE legends to get them on the card in some capacity.

It was previously reported Saudi officials are preparing an offer to The Rock that would be the largest payday ever given to any wrestler to work a single show in the history of the sport.

WWE has dreamed of a Rock-Roman Reigns match for years. The closest it ever got was in 2024 when the Great One appeared on the first Raw of the year to tease a bout with the Tribal Chief that was then scuttled when Cody Rhodes won the Royal Rumble, though The Rock did wrestle on the show in a tag match.

If The Rock is going to do another match, one would assume he would want it to be sooner than later given that he will turn 55 on May 2 and it requires a lot of physical training to keep his body in the shape to be The Rock everyone thinks of in a WWE ring.

WWE Figuring Out Drew McIntyre's Return Storyline

Having been off WWE television since WrestleMania to work on various outside projects, Drew McIntyre is now waiting for creative to find a story to get him back in the ring.

Per PWInsider Elite (h/t Derek Holloway of Ringside News), McIntyre is back in the United States after completing work on his other commitments, but WWE's creative team hasn't started plotting out his return at this point.

McIntyre lost to Jacob Fatu in an unsanctioned match at WrestleMania 42. The bout was done to write the Scottish Warrior off television for the time being due to being cast in the Highlander reboot and the Russell Crowe-starring The Last Druid .

The Last Druid started filming in Spain in June. Crowe posted a picture with McIntyre on Instagram on Aug. 5, writing they had recently finished filming.

One thing potentially holding up McIntyre's return is all of the people he was feuding with prior to leaving are embroiled in storylines right now. His last two opponents prior to Fatu were Sami Zayn and Cody Rhodes over the undisputed title.

The decision also has to be made if McIntyre will return as a heel or babyface. If he is staying on SmackDown, it might be better to bring him back as a babyface since they just turned Zayn heel and Randy Orton also returned as a villain.

Of course, the Raw roster also needs an infusion of talent, particularly on the heel side. Roman Reigns is the only top level heel—assuming that's what he is supposed to be given his current rivalry with Solo Sikoa and LA Knight—on the Red Brand at this point.

Regardless of what role McIntyre plays when he returns, his presence will be welcome since he had been on one of the best runs of his career prior to taking a leave.

Women's Trios Match Potentially Planned for SNME

With just three matches currently official for the upcoming Sunday Night's Main Event show on Sept. 6, WWE could add a women's trios bout to the card.

Per Joey Votes of WrestleVotes (h/t Felix Upton of Ringside News), WWE has "loosely discussed" putting Fatal Influence vs. Charlotte Flair, Alexa Bliss and Tatum Paxley on the SNME show.

"I do know the women's trios match—Fatal Influence vs. Alexa, Tatum, and Charlotte—has been loosely discussed to make that card. They are treating this event as a PLE-lite," JoeyVotes said.

The only matches set for the show are Rhodes vs. Orton, Oba Femi vs. Bron Breakker and Baron Corbin vs. Lil Yachty in which Yachty needs to last five minutes to earn Trick Williams a rematch with Corbin for the U.S. title.

WWE has generally put five matches on Saturday Night's Main Event cards, though there have been some exceptions. The Jan. 24 show from Montreal only had three matches take place, though a fourth was scheduled between Rhodes and Fatu that never occurred due to a pre-match brawl.

It would make sense to have the match take place, whether it's on the Sept. 6 card or waiting until Money in the Bank on Oct. 10. Fatal Influence have been feuding with Flair on and off for most of the year. Paxley just recently debuted on SmackDown, so giving her a high-profile match would help elevate her profile.

One thing of note is WWE didn't announce any new matches for SNME during the SmackDown tapings on Monday night for the show airing this week, so the last chance to make it official on the go-home episode on Sept. 4 if it's going to happen.

articles.title: Could Gavin McKenna push Auston Matthews into a new role in the Toronto Maple Leafs NHL lineup
articles.summary: NHL News: With the Toronto Maple Leafs drafting Gavin McKenna first overall, the possibility of reshaping their lineup around him raises intriguing questions about Auston Matthews' role and potential scoring combinations this NHL season.
articles.body: The Toronto Maple Leafs enter the 2026-27 NHL season with the first overall selection in the 2026 NHL Draft, Gavin McKenna, under a microscope. The teenager has yet to play an NHL game, but his arrival is already generating buzz around possible line combinations.Toronto still revolves around Auston Matthews, but the emergence of another top-level offensive talent would give the coaching staff more options. An interesting option would be to have McKenna skate with William Nylander and John Tavares.Could Gavin McKenna join Toronto Maple Leafs top six?Gavin McKenna could be a candidate for a top-six role if he proves in training camp he can handle the speed and physicality of the NHL right away. The Toronto Maple Leafs donât have to push him, but his offensive game could make it harder to decide.William Nylander is entering the season with 79 points, 30 goals and 49 assists in 65 games. At age 35, John Tavares continued to produce, finishing the season with 71 points in 82 games: 31 goals, 40 assists.McKenna joining Nylander and Tavares would give Toronto another potentially potent scoring unit. If the three forwards develop chemistry, it could also pose a tough tactical problem for opposing NHL teams.But that doesnât necessarily mean Auston Matthews would drop in the lineup. Matthews continues to be the leading center for the Toronto Maple Leafs and a huge part of their offensive structure.The training camp and preseason games should be the best barometer for how quickly McKenna can get meaningful NHL minutes. The Toronto coaching staff can see his consistency, defensive responsibility, skating and ability to handle tougher competition before making a decision.A safer bet would be McKenna in a lesser role in the lineup as he adjusts to the NHL. If he adapts quickly, then more responsibility could be on the cards.What would this mean for Auston Matthews?A McKenna breakthrough would provide Jim Hiller with more options in his lineup, notnecessarily take away from the importance of Matthews. Toronto had the ability to spread the scoring out over a number of lines, which may have lessened the burden on one unit to produce the majority of the offence.Right now McKenna's top-six role is still a projection and not a set plan. Still, the possibility is illustrative of the type of buzz surrounding the first overall selection for the Toronto Maple Leafs as the new NHL season approaches.The arrival of Gavin McKenna has prompted new discussion around the Toronto Maple Leafs' forward combinations. The first overall pick could be in line for a top-six role with established scorers William Nylander and John Tavares. If McKenna can make a quick transition, his offensive contributions could give head coach Jim Hiller more flexibility in his lineup next season.Get the latest Sports News and Live updates. articles.title: Periodista defendió veto a la hinchada de Millonarios en Medellín y le llueven críticas por xenofobia
articles.standfirst: Periodista justificó medida contra hinchas de Millonarios y desató la furia azul
articles.summary: Periodista justificó medida contra hinchas de Millonarios y desató la furia azul
articles.body: El debate sobre la convivencia, el control de la violencia y las restricciones a las hinchadas visitantes en el fútbol profesional colombiano volvió a encenderse tras la postura expresada por un periodista deportivo en favor de las medidas de seguridad adoptadas para restringir el ingreso de aficionados de Millonarios en la ciudad de Medellín. Las restricciones para partidos de alto riesgo —que suelen incluir el cierre de fronteras para barras visitantes o protocolos estrictos de identificación— buscan garantizar el orden público y evitar altercados dentro y fuera de los escenarios deportivos. Sin embargo, la defensa pública de estas disposiciones por parte de comunicadores ha generado opiniones divididas en la opinión pública y en las redes sociales. Por un lado, quienes respaldan las medidas argumentan que la prioridad absoluta debe ser la seguridad ciudadana y la integridad de los asistentes al estadio. Desde esta perspectiva, restringir la presencia masiva de hinchadas rivales en encuentros de alta rivalidad minimiza los focos de tensión y facilita la labor de la Policía y las autoridades locales en materia de control y prevención. Por otro lado, sectores de la hinchada 'embajadora' y diversos analistas rechazan la medida y las opiniones que la justifican, catalogándolas como una generalización injusta que castiga a toda la afición por los actos de unos pocos. Los detractores de este tipo de restricciones sostienen que cerrar fronteras o limitar el acceso perpetúa la estigmatización del hincha, limita el derecho a la libre circulación y representa un retroceso en los esfuerzos por vivir el fútbol en paz y con fronteras abiertas. El episodio pone nuevamente en el centro de la discusión el rol de los medios y comunicadores deportivos al abordar temas de seguridad e hinchadas. Mientras algunos consideran que la prensa debe respaldar las decisiones institucionales en pro de la convivencia, otros señalan que el periodismo debe cuestionar medidas restrictivas y promover soluciones de fondo en lugar de avalar soluciones punitivas o de exclusión. La polémica deja en evidencia la compleja relación entre la pasión futbolística, la gestión de la seguridad en las grandes ciudades y el impacto que tienen las opiniones periodísticas en la percepción de los hinchas y el desarrollo de la Liga local.

articles.title: Real Madrid’s Mourinho ‘happy’ with transfers despite Rodri miss
articles.summary: Yan Diomande topped Real’s transfers, and Jose Mourinho says he is happy despite missing out on Rodri to Barcelona.
articles.body:
Real Madrid coach Jose Mourinho says he is “very happy” with his squad, which he considers complete despite missing out on midfielder Rodri, later signed by rivals Barcelona.

Los Blancos revamped their squad this summer, signing six players including record arrival Yan Diomande , Bernardo Silva and Marc Cucurella.

list 1 of 4 Big-spending Tottenham sign Brazilian winger Savinho from Manchester City

list 2 of 4 Premier League: Chelsea start Alonso era with thrilling 3–2 win at Fulham

list 3 of 4 Ex-Liverpool star Fabinho reunited with Mohamed Salah at Trabzonspor

list 4 of 4 Arsenal sign Konsa from Villa as Premier League holders bolster defence

However, Madrid’s approach for Rodri broke down, meaning that, beyond former Man City playmaker Silva, they have not strengthened in midfield.

“For me the squad is closed, but the market is still open – you never know if a player will come and say ‘I’ve been benched twice and I want to leave,'” Mourinho told reporters on Tuesday.

“In theory, no [more deals]… but something could always happen… In my head the squad is closed, and I have not asked for anyone. I am very happy with the players I have.”

With midfield maestros Toni Kroos and Luka Modric departing in 2024 and 2025 respectively, Madrid have struggled to control matches.

Mourinho’s side snatched a late 2-1 win at Espanyol on Saturday in their La Liga opener, starting with Silva and Federico Valverde together in midfield.

Mourinho said French defensive midfielder Aurelien Tchouameni was not ready to play against Real Sociedad on Wednesday.

“He’s got a problem, the holiday time wasn’t enough [for him to recover], seeing the games approaching, the player wanted to try … but we’ve decided that you can’t start a season in suffering,” explained the coach.

“You can finish a season suffering, the last couple of months, but you can’t start in August not at 100 percent.

“So we decided with him, the staff, the medical department, to get him to return at 100 percent.”

Mourinho said he had faith in Uruguayan international Valverde as a midfielder, despite previous coaches using him in a variety of roles, including right-back and right winger.

“For me he is a player for the centre of the pitch,” added Mourinho.

“Depending on the opponent and our objectives, he might be more set in his position or more mobile.”

Mourinho said that in modern football, players’ positions were less relevant.

“I don’t want to identify Tchouameni as the No. 6, Camavinga No. 6, Fede No. 8, Bernardo No. 10 … things dilute during games.”

articles.title: Duro golpe al Deportivo Pereira: Acolfutpro pide formalmente su liquidación judicial por impagos
articles.standfirst: Acolfutpro pide a Supersociedades la liquidación del Deportivo Pereira: las razones de la solicitud
articles.summary: Acolfutpro pide a Supersociedades la liquidación del Deportivo Pereira: las razones de la solicitud
articles.body: La tranquilidad institucional y deportiva del Deportivo Pereira vuelve a tambalearse. La Asociación Colombiana de Futbolistas Profesionales (Acolfutpro) presentó una solicitud formal ante la Superintendencia de Sociedades para que se declare la liquidación judicial del club matecaña, tras denunciar sistemáticos incumplimientos en el pago de las obligaciones laborales del plantel profesional. De acuerdo con el comunicado oficial emitido por el gremio de futbolistas, la institución risaraldense incurrió en el impago de los salarios correspondientes al mes de julio y la primera quincena de agosto, afectando directamente el sustento de los jugadores y sus familias. El punto neurálgico del reclamo radica en la situación jurídica en la que se encuentra la entidad: "Nuestros compañeros del Pereira, quienes ven afectado su sustento y el de sus familias, merecen respeto, cumplimiento y condiciones laborales dignas", señaló Acolfutpro en su pronunciamiento. Esta nueva encrucijada legal y administrativa genera profunda preocupación en la afición pereirana, recordando los oscuros capítulos del pasado en los que el club ya había atravesado un extenso proceso de liquidación. articles.summary: After Brydon Carse dropped by England for second Test against Pakistan, captain Joe Root blasts ‘stupid mistakes’.
articles.body:
Joe Root has expressed frustration that a winning return as England Test captain has been overshadowed by another off-field incident that saw Brydon Carse dropped for the second Test against Pakistan.

Carse has been referred to the Cricket Regulator after videos on social media appeared to show the fast bowler being led away by police in handcuffs following an incident at a nightclub in Derby on Saturday.

It is the latest in a series of alcohol-fuelled controversies that have dogged England since a disastrous tour of New Zealand and Australia at the end of last year.

White-ball captain Harry Brook was involved in an altercation with a nightclub bouncer in Wellington, and videos circulated of opener Ben Duckett appearing drunk on a night out during the 4-1 Ashes series thrashing by Australia.

In June, former captain Ben Stokes and Gus Atkinson were given written warnings and stood down from the second Test against New Zealand after an incident at a London nightclub that occurred after they broke a curfew.

Stokes announced his shock retirement from international cricket during the third Test a few days later, paving the way for Root to return for a second spell as red-ball captain.

England thrashed Pakistan by an innings and 103 runs inside three days of his first match back in charge last week.

“If I’m being brutally honest, I’m really hacked off. I’m really disappointed that after last week’s performance, we’re sat here and we’re talking about something that is not related to it at all,” Root said at a news conference on Tuesday.

“It’s not the isolated incident itself. It’s the fact we continuously keep making stupid mistakes away from the game and it’s detracting from what we are doing on the field.”

A curfew on players going out was introduced in January after the troubled tour Down Under.

However, Root has said he will not impose a curfew because he does not believe it is a productive way to change the culture around the England squad.

“I still don’t believe that’s the way to go. It’s important we create something bigger than that. It’s about having something long lasting that we can be proud of,” the 35-year-old said.

“Clearly, we are not portraying ourselves how we want to, and I think we have an opportunity to build a culture that is very strong, that we can be proud of, that is player-driven, and of course, that isn’t going to happen overnight.

“We have already had conversations as a team on what is expected from this group of players, what it means to play for England, what it takes to play for England.

“We want to create something that we can be proud of, that people who follow us can be proud of.”

Carse was not selected for the first Test and has been withdrawn from the squad for the second Test, which begins at Lord’s on Thursday.

articles.body: Con el inicio del ciclo escolar 2026 cada vez más cerca, las familias mexicanas se preparan para enfrentar una nueva temporada de compras donde los gastos esenciales tendrán un incremento frente al año anterior. De acuerdo con estimaciones de la Alianza Nacional de Pequeños Comerciantes (ANPEC), el equipamiento básico para un estudiante podría superar los 12 mil pesos, considerando los productos necesarios para comenzar clases. El gasto contempla desde la compra de útiles escolares hasta uniformes, zapatos, cuotas escolares y artículos de limpieza solicitados por los planteles. Para muchos hogares, este desembolso representa una presión económica importante al concentrarse en pocas semanas antes del regreso a las aulas. La ANPEC calcula que el gasto básico por estudiante durante el regreso a clases 2026 alcanzará hasta 12 mil 422.06 pesos, cifra superior a los 10 mil 916.02 pesos estimados en 2025, lo que representa un aumento aproximado del 13.80%. El mayor impacto se concentra en los útiles escolares, uniformes y calzado, aunque también se suman gastos adicionales que las familias deben considerar durante todo el ciclo escolar. Datos principales del regreso a clases 2026: La lista de útiles representa uno de los principales desembolsos para los hogares. Entre los productos considerados están cuadernos, lápices, colores, mochilas, calculadoras, materiales de apoyo y artículos para trabajos escolares. El regreso a clases no sólo implica comprar cuadernos y lápices. Las familias también deben contemplar la renovación del uniforme diario, ropa deportiva, zapatos y tenis, elementos que incrementan considerablemente el presupuesto inicial. La ANPEC estima que únicamente el uniforme y el calzado tendrán un costo de hasta 4 mil 895 pesos, con un aumento de 11.25% respecto a la referencia del año pasado. El desglose aproximado incluye: A esto se suma la cuota escolar anual, calculada en alrededor de 3 mil 200 pesos, además de materiales de limpieza que pueden representar casi 370 pesos adicionales. Para las familias, el gasto tampoco termina con las compras previas al inicio de clases. Durante el ciclo escolar deben considerar transporte, alimentos y otros materiales que surgen conforme avanzan las actividades académicas. Además del desembolso inicial, los hogares mexicanos enfrentan gastos recurrentes relacionados con la alimentación y movilidad de los estudiantes. Según las estimaciones comerciales, el transporte escolar puede alcanzar alrededor de 2,500 pesos mensuales, mientras que el lunch representa cerca de 1,500 pesos al mes por estudiante. Esto significa que transporte y alimentación pueden sumar aproximadamente 4 mil pesos mensuales, convirtiéndose en una carga económica constante durante el ciclo escolar. Cuauhtémoc Rivera, presidente de la ANPEC, destacó que el regreso a clases genera una cadena de consumo que continúa después del inicio del ciclo escolar mediante compras diarias de alimentos, bebidas, artículos de higiene y productos básicos para los estudiantes.

articles.title: New NHL Rumors Update Quinn Hughes' Contract Talks, Trade Buzz with Wild Ahead of 2026-27 Season
articles.summary: Three weeks before training camps open and one month before the start of the 2026-27 NHL regular season, Quinn Hughes' future with the Minnesota Wild is becoming a big question mark.
articles.body:
Three weeks before training camps open and one month before the start of the 2026-27 NHL regular season, Quinn Hughes' future with the Minnesota Wild is becoming a big question mark.

On the latest episode of his 32 Thoughts podcast, Elliotte Friedman of Sportsnet said there's no indication there have been "a ton of talks recently between Hughes and the Wild" as he enters the final season of his current contract.

Meanwhile, The Athletic's Michael Russo reported the team has not been engaged with the New Jersey Devils or any team in regards to Hughes:

"One source, speaking on the condition of anonymity to discuss negotiations that aren't public, went as far as to tell The Athletic on Tuesday that the rumors are 'bulls--t,' 'made up' and 'invented BS by bloggers'"

Hughes was acquired by the Wild from the Vancouver Canucks last December. He had spent the first eight years of his career in Vancouver, but a trade came about after his camp reportedly informed Canucks officials at some point early last season that he wouldn't commit to signing an extension.

Minnesota sent Marco Rossi, Zeev Buium, Liam Öhgren and a 2026 first-round pick (No. 24 overall) to Vancouver in exchange for Quinn.

The Athletic's Michael Russo reported on July 2 that Wild general manager Bill Guerin called the New Jersey Devils to inquire about Jack Hughes, Quinn's younger brother, in a potential trade.

No deal came out of those discussions, but it's plausible the Wild were taking steps in an attempt to entice Hughes to sign an extension. The Devils were connected to Quinn before he was traded to Minnesota.

Hughes told reporters in May after the Wild's season ended with a second-round playoff loss to the Colorado Avalanche that he would like some clarity on his future going into next season, adding that he is "open" to an extension with Minnesota.

"I really like it here. I would definitely be open to re-signing. We'll see what Billy wants to do," Hughes said. "We're 36 hours removed [from elimination]. I'm not sure I'm ready to get into details, what they would look like."

One potential issue is the value of a Hughes' extension. He is currently the 35th highest-paid defenseman in the NHL by average annual salary $7.85 million per season on the six-year, $47.1 million deal he signed in October 2021.

Hughes has far exceeded that deal, including winning the Norris Trophy during the 2023-24 season.

Bowen Byram of the Chicago Blackhawks is the highest-paid defenseman at $12.5 million annually on the six-year, $75 million extension he signed in July. Erik Karlsson ($11.5 million), Rasmus Dahlin ($11 million) and Drew Doughty ($11 million) round out the top four defensemen by average annual salary.

Hughes finished last season with 69 assists, eighth-most in the league, and helped the Wild win a playoff series for the first time since 2015.

Minnesota will open the 2026-27 regular season on Oct. 1 against the Nashville Predators.

articles.title: Bianca Belair Reveals Major Injury Update, WWE Star Has 'No Feeling' in Surgically-Repaired Finger

articles.body:
It's been over a year since WWE Superstar Bianca Belair last wrestled, and it doesn't sound like she'll be back in the ring anytime soon.

Belair suffered a significant finger injury that required surgery in her last match at WrestleMania 41 in April 2025. After giving birth to her first child during her time off, Belair revealed on Instagram that she's now dealing with carpal tunnel syndrome in both hands.

"No one ever talks about …this stuff … currently carpal tunnel in both hands… fingers completely numb, no feeling in surgery finger whatsoever, no grip strength, and now also Mom thumb… wtf lol," Belair wrote in her Instagram story (h/t Derek Holloway of Ringside News).

Belair struggled to progress in her recovery from surgery for quite some time, but she dedicated more time to physical therapy during her pregnancy and finally regained the ability to bend her finger. However, she still had visible swelling when she shared an update last month.

Belair was one of WWE's brightest stars and a cornerstone of the women's division, so her presence has been sorely missed. Fans will continue to hope that she will recover and return to reclaim her spot as one of the faces of the company.

articles.title: Chinese robot Tiangong clocks sub-9-second 100 metres in Beijing
articles.summary: Chinese robot seven-tenths of a ⁠second faster than the 9.58-second men’s world record set by Usain Bolt in 100m.
articles.body:
China’s Tiangong ⁠Ultra humanoid robot ran 100 metres in 8.86 seconds at the World Humanoid Robot Games in Beijing on Tuesday, lowering the 9.39-second mark it set at the event’s opening.

The time was more than seven-tenths of a ⁠second faster than the 9.58-second men’s human world record set by Jamaican sprinting great Usain Bolt in 2009.

Tiangong Ultra, developed by the Beijing Humanoid Robot Innovation Center, achieved the new time in the semifinal of the large-size robot division.

The robots’ rapid improvement has been one of the main attractions at the second edition of the Beijing ‌event, where more than 2,000 robots from 666 teams are competing in 51 events including football, dancing and industrial-task contests.

Tiangong won the 100-metre (328-foot) race at last year’s inaugural games with a much slower time of 21.50 seconds, months after clinching victory at the world’s first humanoid robot half-marathon in Beijing last year with an amateur-level time of 2 hours 40 minutes.

“Reading that a motor-powered robot can run faster than a human is one thing,” said Li Hui, 26, an engineer with Fudan University’s table-tennis team. “Seeing it ⁠rush past you during training is completely different. You realise how impressive it ⁠is.”

Tiangong completed its sub-nine-second sprint by striking a thick mat placed beyond the finish line to stop the sprinting machines. A small fire appeared in the robot’s torso after it collapsed from the impact. In the other semifinal, a robot disassembled mid-race.

The sub-nine-second sprint followed Tiangong’s opening-day win on Saturday, when it overtook smartphone maker Honor’s Lightning near the finish after falling behind early. Lightning ⁠recorded 9.47 seconds, also under Bolt’s record. Honor had previously recorded ⁠a faster time of 9.32 seconds in a test run.

The Beijing Humanoid Robot Innovation Center said earlier on Tuesday that its Tiangong robots had already beaten four human world records. Besides the 100m sprint, it pointed to a 400m time of 38.15 seconds, a 1,500m ‌mark of 2 minutes 21.64 seconds, and a 2.88-metre-high jump.

The centre’s shareholder list includes state-owned enterprises, several investment funds, AI and cloud giant Baidu, and smartphone and EV maker Xiaomi’s robotics unit, according to Chinese corporate ‌data ‌provider Qichacha.

China has designated humanoid robots a strategic emerging industry, as companies and policymakers seek to translate advances in artificial intelligence, motors and sensors into uses in manufacturing, logistics and services.

articles.title: Crystal Palace: Why is Premier League club's home kit white?
articles.summary: BBC Sport's Ask Me Anything team explains why Crystal Palace are wearing a white home shirt during the 2026-27 season
articles.body:
For the first time in almost two decades, Crystal Palace will wear a white home shirt for the duration of the 2026-27 Premier League season.

Traditionally, the Eagles have worn a blue and red strip. White is also a colour associated with the club, and while it is often a secondary tone in home shirts across the past 40 years, it has frequently featured as the primary shade on away and alternate jerseys.

But Palace have this year opted to wear a white home strip. It includes a blue and a red sash diagonally across the chest, in keeping with the club's traditional colours.

Palace say that the kit is a nod to their shirt worn 50 years ago. Having featured a sash during their run to the semi-finals of the FA Cup in 1976, the following season saw the club implement the shirt for the duration of the campaign.

Following that initial use, the white strip with a blue and red sash was worn frequently by the club during the early 1980s.

The strip also contains the use of Palace's former circular badge, worn by the club between 1973 and 1987.

Palace wore the shirt for the first time competitively in their 2-0 away defeat to Everton on the opening fixture of the season.

Pierre Sage's side will wear the shirt at Selhurst Park for the first time on Friday night when they host Manchester City in their first home match of the campaign.

The last time Palace wore a white shirt as their home kit was during the 2008-09 season, which the club spent in the Championship.

articles.title: Luke Littler suffers Players Championship 27 quarter-final exit with loss to eventual winner Jermaine Wattimena
articles.summary: Luke Littler has won every major on PDC circuit so far in 2026 in bid for historic clean sweep; world No 1 must finish in top 64 of Players Championship Order of Merit in order to qualify for Finals in November; 19-year-old lost 6-5 to eventual PC27 winner Jermaine Wattimena in last eight
articles.body:
Littler was beaten 6-5 by Jermaine Wattimena in a final-leg decider, with the Dutchman going on to take the title in Leicester, overcoming countryman Kevin Doets 8-6 in the final.

Littler beat Archie Self 6-2, Arno Merk 6-3 and then William O'Connor 6-3 to set up a last-16 tie with Chris Dobey, who he thrashed 6-0, before losing out to eventual champion Wattimena.

The world No 1 has won every major title on the PDC circuit so far in 2026 - the World Championship, Masters, UK Open, Premier League, World Cup of Darts and World Matchplay.

He still needs to win the World Series, World Grand Prix, European Championship, Grand Slam of Darts and Players Championship Finals this season in order to achieve something no-one has ever managed in the sport.

Can Littler still qualify for Players Championship Finals?

The major obstacle standing in the way of a Littler clean sweep is that only the top 64 in the Players Championship Order of Merit make it through to the finals in Minehead in November, with the projected cut-off expected to be over £30,000 in earnings.

The winner of each Players Championship event scoops up £15,000 but Littler was able to secure only £4,000 by reaching the quarter-finals on his season-debut outing.

The 19-year-old opted out of the first 26 events before entering PC27 and 28 in Leicester, meaning he needs to have strong showings in the final seven scheduled floor events to stand a chance of qualifying.

PC28 on Wednesday, also being held at the Mattioli Arena in Leicester, gives him another opportunity to claim a tournament win and boost his finals hopes.

Wattimena fended off a late fightback Doets to clinch his third PDC ranking title with victory in the Players Championship 27 showpiece on Tuesday.

Following his dramatic, first career win against Littler, sealed with a clutch 115 checkout on tops in a last-leg decider, Wattimena produced further heroics in his semi-final against Luke Woodhouse, reeling off six straight legs from 4-1 down, aided by an astonishing flurry of five ton-plus finishes.

Wattimena converted 136, 135, 115, 127 and 128 outshots to complete the comeback, before winning six straight legs against Doets to power into a commanding 6-2 lead.

Doets responded by winning four of the next five to threaten an improbable turnaround, only for Wattimena to fire in a brilliant 11-darter en route to victory.

"I played really well today but some games I made difficult for myself," conceded Wattimena, who reclaims a place in the world's top 16 at the expense of Ross Smith.

"I always play really well against Luke to be honest. Even when I lose I play well, and that 115 finish against Luke gave me big confidence.

"I didn't realise I hit five ton-plus finishes in the semi-final because you're busy with the game, but I'm very happy with this win."

Nathan Aspinall was another high-profile name in action, and the Stockport star struck perfection during his opening round tie against Thibault Tricole, before succumbing to Mickey Mansell in round three.

articles.title: Kenneth Walker is the latest addition to the Kansas City Chiefs' growing injury list ahead of preseason Week 3
articles.summary: The Kansas City Chiefs' injury list added another starter with preseason Week 3's game with the Seattle Seahawks just a few days away.
articles.body:
The Kansas City Chiefs ' injury list added another starter with preseason Week 3's game with the Seattle Seahawks just a few days away.

The Kansas City Chiefs added a concerning new injury to the report on Tuesday, Aug. 25. Chiefs PR informed reporters during Tuesday media availability that RB Kenneth Walker was added to the injury report with a foot injury. As a result, the team did not expect him to participate in practice on Tuesday. Walker did participate in practice on Monday, following the preseason Week 2 loss to the Tampa Bay Buccaneers . That suggests this is a new injury that was suffered during the practice week. The other players expected to miss practice on Tuesday:

We won't hear any specifics about Walker's injury until Andy Reid speaks to the media on Wednesday. The Chiefs have been very cautious with injuries this offseason, notably dialing some guys back when necessary.

Chiefs RB Kenneth Walker's injury history raises concerns here

Injuries have been a major subplot in Kenneth Walker's NFL career so far. It's one of the biggest reasons people doubt his ability to be a workhorse running back in Kansas City. Walker missed Week 1 of his rookie season in 2022 due to a hernia. He suffered an ankle sprain later in the year that kept him out of a divisional game. In 2023, he suffered an oblique injury along with groin and shoulder injuries. He also missed several different stretches of the 2024 NFL season due to ankle, calf, and oblique injuries. The foot injury is something new, and it's rarely a good injury for a running back to deal with. Even if it's minor, it can easily be aggravated. However, the timing is a bit of a saving grace.

The timing is the good news about this injury

The Kansas City Chiefs open the 2026 NFL season on Monday Night Football against the Denver Broncos . Their Week 1 matchup is 22 days away. Walker doesn't need to participate in preseason Week 3. He'll be anxious to participate because it's against his former team, the Seattle Seahawks. The team can simply put him on ice, let the foot injury heal, and hope that he's ready to get back out there for Week 1 of the regular season. That's, of course, if the injury is determined to be nothing serious that would keep him out for a longer stretch of time. Thankfully, the Chiefs do have some talented depth behind Walker this season in Emari Demercado , Emmett Johnson, and Brashard Smith .
